reasons.text: The label photo is the same image as a photo on another claim in the program, so this claim is flagged for review.
The label is legible and shows REV 12 Kids Bike, which is a recalled model, and the typed model matches.
The purchase is from REI.com, a listed retailer, within the sale window, and no receipt is required.
The typed serial QQ52456269 does not begin with a recalled prefix (ET22, ET23, 01VX, or 07VX), so it is outside the recalled range. This is a deny factor, but the duplicate flag takes precedence.
The date code 2022 is within the recalled range.
